title: Product Backstage — Daily Journal
content:
Quick notes and raw log — mix of action items, friction points, and tiny drafts. Rough, will clean later.

2026-03-12 / 09:10 — morning capture
- Goal for next 48h: lock PRD scope for v1 launch (telemetry + rollout gating), finalize canary playbook, get SRE buy-in on autoscale guardrails.
- Today focus: PRD edits (acceptance criteria + telemetry), follow up w/ legal on data retention blurb, finalize handoff checklist for SE team.

09:30 meeting with Kevin (eng) — main outcomes
- KV cache behavior: need explicit note for PRD about warm-up window (first 2m degraded p95). Add example traffic profile.
- Kevin: will add micro-bench numbers to PRD appendix (p50/p95 on rtx-a100-ish) by EOD Wed.

PRD edits to make (inline drafting tasks)
- Add a short "Failure modes" section: (a) model fallback path when Dedicated capacity exhausted, (b) prefix cache miss storm, (c) KMS transient errors.
- Acceptance criteria (MUST):
  * p50 generation latency <= 150ms for 256-token typical seq under Dedicated baseline
  * p95 <= 500ms for same traffic profile
  * Error budget for 7d rolling window: < 0.5% 5xxs at route level
- Add telemetry: route-level token-rate, per-request cost estimate, cache-hit rate, kv-cache-warmup-duration.
- Note: tie quality regression alerts to prompt-suite (PRD-124) — link above.

Stakeholder follow-ups (to send / done)
- Marta (SRE): confirm fallback autoscale thresholds; asked to review canary rollback script. (ACTION: ping Marta Thu morning)
- Jonah (Solutions eng): need customer-facing one-pager for Dedicated offering; send a 1-page sketch by Fri. (ACTION: draft outline now)
- Legal (K. Patel): clarify retention language for private deployments. Submitted question via legal queue yesterday, no reply. (ACTION: escalate if no reply by Thu)

Launch preflight (quick checklist, live statuses)
- PRD final draft: in progress (this file + inline edits)
- E2E test harness: blocked (infra config mismatch, infra ticket INF-8793)
- Console rollout UI: design approved, dev tickets created -> assigned to Kevin
- Observability dashboards: template ready, needs dashboards wired to test cluster (SRE)
- Canary plan: draft done, needs exact thresholds from SRE
- Docs: SE-facing runbook skeleton created (docs/runbooks/dedicated-launch)

Micro-tasks (today)
- [ ] Insert "Failure modes" section + short mitigations into PRD (30m)
- [ ] Add telemetry signals list and sample metrics (chart names) (20m)
- [ ] Draft one-pager skeleton for Jonah (15m)
- [ ] Follow up on INF-8793 (E2E infra) with infra-engineering (Megan) (10m)
- [ ] Slack legal about retention (copy of exact language) (5m)

Timeboxed log (rough)
- 09:00–09:40: syncs & capture
- 09:45–10:15: PRD global edits (failure modes + acceptance criteria)
- 10:20–10:40: quick draft one-pager outline
- 10:50–11:10: ping infra + add JIRA notes
- 11:30–12:00: call w/ Marta (SRE) — confirm canary rollback hooks

Open questions / parking lot
- How permissive should the rollback policy be for Dedicated customers with long-running sessions? (tradeoff: user experience vs capacity fairness)
- Do we want an explicit "graceful degradation" route in the API to return cached partial responses when model servers are saturated? (pros/cons noted)
- Need cost-estimate template for SEs to present to customers (per-1000-token baseline + typical hit-rate assumptions).

Notes to self (capture language snippets for PRD)
- "Redwood Dedicated is provisioned to maintain latency SLOs under committed baseline; automatic fallback to compatible model variants occurs when capacity constraints are detected. Customers are notified via console and can configure fallback policies per-route."
- Short blurb for docs: "Canary rollout runs traffic at 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automatic rollback on quality regressions or exceeded error budget."

End-of-day quick triage (2026-03-12 / 18:45)
- Kevin delivered micro-bench placeholders (need formatting)
- Marta flagged a small caveat on autoscale cadence (increase check interval from 30s->60s) — update PRD note
- Legal still pending
- Next day plan: finish PRD final pass and send to launch-review channel, prepare SE one-pager, confirm infra unblock for E2E harness.

Random scratch (brain dump)
- Possible follow-up project idea: "prefix-caching-telemetry" — lightweight agent that surfaces warmup durations per-model-per-route. Could save $$ by tuning warmup TTLs. Put in backlog if low effort.

-- Aisha
